free_tier.stated: A recurring monthly free allowance per voice class, not a one-time credit: 'WaveNet voices 0 to 4 million characters', 'Standard voices 0 to 4 million characters', 'Chirp 3: HD voices 0 to 1 million characters', 'Studio voices 0 to 1 million characters', 'Neural2 voices 0 to 1 million characters'. Over the allowance the price is 'US$4 per 1 million characters' for WaveNet and Standard, 'US$30 per 1 million' for Chirp 3 HD and Studio at 'US$160 per 1 million'. At the common 1,000 characters a minute, 4 million characters is about 66 hours of speech a month.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: What breaks: the Gemini-family TTS models have 'Not available' in the free column, so the newest voices are excluded, and an accidental loop over a long document bills at USD 4 per million characters.

limits.value: the allowance resets monthly but the account must be a billing account: 'You must enable billing to use Text-to-Speech, and will be automatically charged if your usage exceeds the number of free characters allowed per month', so a card is required before the first character is synthesised and an overrun bills silently.
